story.originalTitle: Expanding opportunities in grassroots rallying! 🏁 The FIA WMSC has approved the introduction of new homologation and technical regulations for Rall...
story.summaryEn:
Expanding opportunities in grassroots rallying! 🏁
The FIA WMSC has approved the introduction of new homologation and technical regulations for Rally6 cars, creating a more affordable and accessible entry point into competitive rallying 👏👏
With an estimated cost of €35,000 to €47,000, the new category aims to reduce financial barriers to participation, strengthen grassroots motor sport and provide a clear development pathway for the next generation of rally drivers 💪
#FIA
detailZh:
基层拉力赛的机会正在扩大！ 🏁
国际汽联世界摩托车运动委员会（FIA WMSC）已批准引入新的认证和技术规则，适用于Rally6车型，为有竞争力的拉力赛创造了一个更经济、更易于进入的起点 👏👏
新类别预计成本为35,000至47,000欧元，旨在降低参与门槛，加强基层赛车运动，并为新一代拉力赛车手提供明确的发展路径 💪
#FIA

Expanding opportunities in grassroots rallying! 🏁
